source: Dropout deserves a practical warning. Current ZXNAME0000XZ scaled_dot_product_attention always applies dropout according to its dropout_p argument, so callers must pass ZXMATH0000XZ during evaluation when dropout should be disabled.[10]
zh: 辍学者应该受到实际的警告。当前的 ZXNAME0000XZ scaled_dot_product_attention 始终根据其 dropout_p 参数应用 dropout，因此当应禁用 dropout 时，调用者必须在评估期间通过 ZXMATH0000XZ。 [10]
